program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1)
      (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) r0) (= (first p) r1) (= (second p) c0) (= (second p) c1)))
              (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1)))
    (define (same-cells? a b)
      (and (= (length a) (length b)) (all? (lambda (p) (member? p b)) a)))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 7)) (objects g 0))])
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb)) (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb))
             (inside (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0))
                             (positions-in-rect (+ r0 1) (+ c0 1) (- r1 1) (- c1 1)))))
        (if (same-cells? (obj-cells obj) (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1))
            (paint-cells out inside 8)
            out)))))
